name: GPT-Transcribe
access: OpenAI API (Audio transcriptions; Realtime committed-turn transcription over WebSocket)

voice.input_audio: Audio files up to 25 MB in mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, wav or webm; in a Realtime session, committed audio turns over WebSocket; text context through prompt, keywords and languages [openai-guide-speech-to-text] [openai-guide-transcription-rt]
voice.turn_detection: None: the model transcribes a finished file or a committed turn; in a Realtime session transcription begins after the client sends input_audio_buffer.commit [openai-guide-transcription-rt]
voice.interruption: Not applicable: the model transcribes and does not speak
voice.latency: Artificial Analysis non-streaming speed factor 41.4 (seconds of audio transcribed per second) [aa-stt-non-streaming]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: $0.0045 per minute of audio; billed by duration, not by tokens

benchmarks.name: AA-WER v2 (Artificial Analysis, non-streaming, percent, lower is better)
